quote: Payment shall be made no later than 30 (thirty) days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority’s Engineer for certification in accordance with the provisions of Clause 17.4
notes: Payment is due no later than 30 days from submission of the Stage Payment Statement. Interest at Bank Rate + 3% is payable on late payment (17.7.2). Shorter sub-periods also exist: the Engineer recommends release of 90% within 10 days and the Authority pays within 10 days (17.5.1, PDF p76); the IPC is issued within 15 days (17.5.2, PDF p76). The final payment certificate is also paid within 30 days (17.7.1(b)).

quote: From every payment for Works due to the Contractor in accordance with the provisions of Clause 17.5, the Authority shall deduct 6% (six per cent) thereof as guarantee money for performance of the obligations of the Contractor during the Construction Period (the “Retention Money”) subject to the condition that the maximum amount of Retention Money shall not exceed 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price.
notes: 6% is deducted from every payment ('Retention Money'); the total retained may not exceed 5% of the Contract Price. The Contractor may replace it with a bank guarantee (7.5.3). Footnote 5 on this page says the Authority may omit clause 7.5 and raise the Performance Security from 5% to 7.5% instead.

quote: The Authority shall make an advance payment (the “Advance Payment”), equal to 10% (ten per cent)7 of the Contract Price, for mobilisation expenses and for acquisition of equipment.
notes: Advance Payment of 10% of the Contract Price for mobilisation and equipment, in two equal instalments, with simple interest at 8% a year. Each instalment needs a bank guarantee for 110% (17.2.2 and 17.2.3). Recovery starts once cumulative interim payments reach 50% of the Contract Price and takes at most 30% of each certificate (17.2.5, PDF p75). Footnote 7 allows up to 15% for large projects.

quote: it shall pay Damages to the Authority in a sum calculated at the rate of 0.05% (zero point zero five per cent) of the Contract Price for delay of each day reckoned from the date specified in Schedule - I
notes: The Contractor pays 0.05% of the Contract Price for each day of delay, counted from the Schedule-I date, but only if a milestone or the Scheduled Completion Date is missed by more than 30 days. Total damages may not exceed 10% of the Contract Price (cap in 10.3.3). The damages are refunded (without interest) if the Works finish by the Scheduled Completion Date. NOT counted: damages for late Performance Security (0.05% a day, 7.1.3, PDF p38), damages the Authority pays for late Right of Way (8.3), and the early-completion bonus of 0.03% a day up to 3% (PDF p82).

quote: the amounts payable to the Contractor for and in respect of Works shall be adjusted for any increase or decrease in the index cost of inputs, by the addition or subtraction of the amounts determined in accordance with the formulae specified in Clause 17.8.4.
notes: Index-based price adjustment (formulae using CPI and WPI) for labour, cement, steel, fuel and other inputs, applied stage by stage (17.8.4). No adjustment if the certificate relates to a month within 3 months of the Base Date. Price adjustment is due only for stages billed within 30 days of the Project Milestone (17.9, PDF p80). The percentage weights in the table are in brackets (placeholders).

quote: an irrevocable and unconditional guarantee, for an amount equal to 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price, from a Bank in the form set forth in Annex-I of Schedule-F
notes: Bank guarantee for 5% of the Contract Price, provided within 15 days of the Agreement and valid until 60 days after the Defects Liability Period. An extension security of 5% of the estimated cost of Structures and Major Bridges applies if the DLP is extended. Footnote 5 (PDF p39) allows raising it to 7.5% if retention is omitted.
